topic_thesis: Trading gurus sell candlestick patterns as a science, but reading charts to predict short-term market direction is just expensive astrology where 93% of retail traders lose money.
strategic_angle: Expose the Technical Analysis fallacy promoted by course sellers: candlestick patterns (Doji, Hammer, Head & Shoulders) have no statistical edge over a coin flip once brokerage, slippage, and STT are accounted for. Reveal SEBI's hard data showing ₹1.81 Lakh Crore lost by retail traders while course creators profit purely on subscription fees.
key_statistic: 93% retail loss rate / ₹1.81 Lakh Crore lost (SEBI F&O Study FY22-FY24)
target_emotion: Cynical realization and protective skepticism against trading courses and chart prediction gimmicks
pinned_comment_text: Do you believe candlestick charts actually predict tomorrow's price, or is it pure astrology? Comment 'TRUTH' to get our breakdown on why technical indicators fail retail traders! 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Localize for Tamil retail audiences lured by 'Share Market Classes' and Telegram tips. Use punchy Tanglish terms like 'Candlestick Jothidam', 'Buy-aa Sell-aa Nu Guessing Game', 'Course Fee Trap', and cite SEBI-in 93% Loss Report to dismantle the dream of overnight trading riches.
